subject: Compliance handshake: SOC2, audit logs, retention, DPA — summary & proposed timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan@finhex.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance handshake: SOC2, audit logs, retention, DPA — summary & proposed timeline

Jordan / Lena — thanks for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a proposed set of next steps to keep momentum on evidence and contractual items. I tried to keep this tight so your engineering and security teams can action items quickly.

Summary of what you shared (pain & goals)
- Primary concern: audit log retention (events for user requests + admin actions) and ability to retrieve filtered logs for investigations.
- Regulatory driver: FinHex needs 12 months of immutable event history but wants an option to set shorter per-environment retention for cost management.
- Contractual concerns: DPA scope (data residency + subprocessors), SOC 2 report availability and recent pen-test snapshots for vendor risk team.
- Timeline pressure: procurement & legal team need acceptance language in the DPA and evidence packet within 3 weeks to hit Q3 rollout.

What Redwood can provide (high level)
- SOC 2: We can share our latest SOC 2 Type II summary report and control matrix. Full report available under NDA.
- Audit logs: Default 90-day storage; we support per-customer retention policies up to 24 months on Dedicated/Private modes. Hosted customers can request retention exceptions (we log approvals).
- Evidence & pen test: We maintain pen-test result summaries and the remediation tracker. For deeper artifacts (full findings), we require an NDA and coordination with our security team to redact sensitive details.
- DPA: We have a standard DPA; redline process is documented (legal review + security sign-off). Minor edits (data residency clauses, subprocessors) are typically handled within 7–10 business days.

Action items & proposed owners / dates
1) Evidence ask spreadsheet (attached) — FinHex to confirm which artifacts are required vs. optional by 2026-06-22. (Owner: Jordan)
2) SOC 2 summary + control matrix — Redwood to share summary PDF and a redacted report under NDA by 2026-06-21. (Owner: Marissa)
3) Audit log retention confirmation — Redwood to confirm retention options and any billing delta for >90 days by 2026-06-18. (Owner: Karthik)
4) Pen test window & NDA — If FinHex wants full findings, sign NDA; propose pen-test disclosure call week of 2026-06-28. (Owner: Soojin)
5) DPA redlines — FinHex to send initial redlines, Redwood legal to respond within 7–10 business days after receipt. (Owner: Marissa)

Attachments included: FinHex-evidence-ask.csv (simple table you can edit) and Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf (high-level controls summary).

Preferred next step: Quick 30-min sync with your security + procurement on Friday 2026-06-18 or Monday 2026-06-21 to align the evidence packet. Please confirm which works and whether you want Redwood legal on the call.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the packet aligned so procurement can move forward.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment stubs:
- FinHex-evidence-ask.csv (spreadsheet)
- Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf (PDF summary, redacted)

From: Jordan Smith <jordan@finhex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@finhex.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance handshake: SOC2, audit logs, retention, DPA — summary & proposed timeline

Thanks Marissa — useful summary. A couple quick clarifications before we update the spreadsheet: 

1) When you say 'per-customer retention policies up to 24 months on Dedicated/Private' — is that configurable per-environment (prod/staging) and enforceable via API? Our ops team needs programmatic controls.
2) For the SOC 2 "summary + control matrix" — can you confirm whether the controls map includes encryption-in-transit and key management details (KMIP/HSM usage)? That is a blocker for our risk team.
3) Pen test: we need confirmation that prior pen-test reports include external network and application-layer tests; if redacted reports are the only option, we may need a short, certified summary for our vendor scoring.

Can you also confirm whether there's an expected charge for extending retention beyond the default? If so, rough ballpark helps for procurement.

If it's easier, we can do a 30-min call Friday with my engineer (Lena) and our procurement lead to go through the spreadsheet live. Friday afternoon (PST) works best.

—Jordan
Jordan Smith
Head of Security Operations, FinHex
jordan@finhex.com | +1 (646) 555-0145

On Wed, Jun 17, 2026 at 3:12 PM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference> wrote:
> Jordan / Lena — thanks for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a proposed set of next steps to keep momentum on evidence and contractual items. I tried to keep this tight so your engineering and security teams can action items quickly.
> 
> [snip — summary and proposed owners / dates]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan@finhex.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.inference>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@finhex.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance handshake: SOC2, audit logs, retention, DPA — summary & proposed timeline

Jordan — thanks for the questions. Answers below and next steps to keep things moving.

1) Retention configuration and API
- Yes: on Dedicated and Private customers, retention is configurable per-tenant and per-environment (prod / staging / test). We expose retention controls via the Account API (Accounts. SetRetention). I don't think you'll need to call it frequently — it's typically set by ops. I'll ask Karthik to share API docs excerpt after this thread.
- Hosted customers: we can set retention by request; if you need automated controls we'll propose a scoped config in the Dedicated plan.

2) SOC 2 control mapping (encryption & key management)
- Our SOC 2 control matrix includes sections on encryption-in-transit and at-rest, and references our KMS provider and HSM usage for root keys. The summary PDF includes the mapping; full matrices require an NDA. We'll attach the high-level mapping in the follow-up.

3) Pen test scope and redactions
- Pen-tests cover external network and application layer by default. For detailed findings, we require an NDA + a short disclosure call so our security team can walk through redactions. We can provide a certified summary (signed by our security lead) for vendor scoring if that helps.

4) Pricing for extended retention
- There is a modest incremental charge for retention >90 days on Hosted; for Dedicated we can include retention in the capacity commitment or as an add-on. I'll get a ballpark from finance and send a note by EOD 2026-06-18. (Owner: Marissa / Finance)

Next steps
- Karthik will post the Account API snippet (Accounts.SetRetention) and the relevant docs here by EOD.
- I'll share the SOC2 summary + redacted control matrix under a simple NDA. I'll send the NDA template in a separate email and attach the redacted PDF once the NDA is in place.
- Proposed call: Friday 2026-06-18, 2:30pm PT — 30 minutes. Agenda: quick runs through the spreadsheet, retention options, and DPA redline expectations. Please confirm and we'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — we'll aim to have the evidence packet skeleton complete for your procurement review by 2026-06-22.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment stubs:
- FinHex-evidence-ask.csv (spreadsheet)
- Redwood-SOC2-summary.pdf (PDF summary, redacted)
- DPA-diff-markup.docx (placeholder for redline suggestions)
